sections.heading: The short version
sections.text: Luis Alejandro Gutierrez (born July 31, 2003) is a Venezuelan professional baseball pitcher for the San Diego Padres of Major League Baseball (MLB).

sections.heading: Lately
sections.text: Gutierrez split the 2025 season between Single–A Lake Elsinore Storm, the High–A Fort Wayne TinCaps, Double–A San Antonio Missions, and Triple–A El Paso Chihuahuas. He made 25 appearances (including 21 starts) for the four affiliates, posting a cumulative 5–6 record and 3.31 ERA with 115 strikeouts across 125 innings pitched. In 2026, Gutierrez logged 13 total starts split between Lake Elsinore, Fort Wayne, San Antonio, and El Paso, compiling an aggregate 1–3 record and 4.25 ERA with 44 strikeouts over 36 innings of work. On November 2, 2026, the Padres selected Gutierrez's contract, adding him to their 40–man roster.
